text:
Linda S: FYI escalation from AcmeHealth — seeing large spike in 429s on reserved-pool-3 after they switched plan tags at ~03:30 UTC. Customer says calls were fine then started failing immediately. I grabbed controller logs and quota records.

Alex G: can you paste the sample 429 and the quota config you pulled? quick look helps.

Linda S: pasted below (redacted):
```
2025-11-04T03:31:12Z INFO rate_limit=429 tenant=acme_health pool=reserved-pool-3 route=/v1/generate reason=quota_exceeded
quota_record: id=qr_9a2f tenant=acme_health units=1000 denom=BYTES_PER_HOUR applied_at=2025-11-04T03:30:58Z
usage_window: last_60s_tokens=3500 last_60s_bytes=1250000
```
Looks like the quota record was created by the plan migration job. The denom stuck as BYTES_PER_HOUR whereas all our serving signals are tokens/minute for this pool.

Maria P: that denom mismatch will make the rate-controller interpret the tenant as having essentially 0 tokens for our token-based tokenization workload. autoscaler uses token-based telemetry too so it probably never saw the spike and didn't scale.

Jamal K: confirmed — I checked the autoscaler logs:
```
[03:31:20] pool=reserved-pool-3 metric=token_rate value=0.0 threshold=1500 decision=no-scale reason=tenant_quota_applied
[03:32:05] enqueue_throttle tenant=acme_health requests=120 429s=87
```

Alex G: this is a conversion bug from the plan-migrate job that ran earlier. It writes quota records with the plan denom field but doesn't translate plan units when the plan's measurement type changed (bytes->tokens). Need a fix and a quick rollback for the affected tenants.

Tom O: immediate workaround: set a temporary override for acme_health to a sane tokens/min value so traffic resume while we patch the migration. I can apply a tenant override for 1 hour.

Linda S: customer is asking for ETA. I'll tell them we're on it and applying a temporary override.

Alex G: repro + fix steps I'm going to run now: 
1) inspect current quota: `redwoodctl get-quota --tenant acme_health --pool reserved-pool-3 --json`
2) set override: `redwoodctl set-quota --tenant acme_health --units 10000 --denom TOKENS_PER_MINUTE --scope override --ttl 3600`
3) patch migration job to include denom conversion and replay for affected tenants.

Maria P: also postmortem items: add validation in plan-migrate to reject denom mismatches, add unit conversion tests, and add an alert for sudden drop in pool token_rate when tenant usage > X.

Jamal K: I've applied the override (Tom and I coordinated). Monitoring shows 429s dropping already: 429s/min -> 6 -> 1 in last 2 minutes. Latency back to baseline. Will keep watch for 15 minutes.

DeployBot: automated job plan-migrate v2025.11.04 ran at 03:30:58 UTC, changed 312 quota records, flagged 4 with denom mismatch (acme_health included).

Alex G: I'll file an infra task to patch the migration and kick a targeted replay for the 4 tenants flagged. Assigning to me (Alex G). Expected fix + replay in next 2 hours, temporary override will cover until then.

Linda S: I updated the customer with the workaround and ETA. They're relieved. I'll keep the thread posted on any regression.

Maria P: monitoring note: adding a short-term guard in autoscaler: if requests/second > 50 for a tenant but token_rate=0, ignore tenant quota for scaling decisions for 5m. We'll bake a safer rule later.

Jamal K: will follow up with postmortem once replay confirms stable. Action items: Alex rollback + replay, Maria autoscaler tweak, Tom keep override until replay done, Linda keep customer updated.

Tom O: override TTL set, will extend if replay delayed.

Linda S: thanks all :thumbsup: closing loop when replay completes and 429s remain < 1/min for 30m.
